facts.fact: Vision Media reports that Rwanda is testing Tunga, an AI voice assistant integrated into the agriculture ministry's call centre that answers farmers' questions in Kinyarwanda, and that it correctly answered at least 60% of questions during testing.

Vision Media reports that Rwanda has completed soil profiling and is developing AI fertiliser recommendations tailored to local soils with Morocco, with early tests indicating yield increases of about 20% and applications still at pilot stage.

systems.platform: voice assistant in the MINAGRI call centre
systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources
